title: Eluder-Dimension-Free Regret for Stage-Wise Constrained Contextual Bandits via Offline Regression
abstract: arXiv:2505.07101v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Contextual bandits with stage-wise constraints model decisions that must control risk while learning from their outcomes. We study this problem when only the selected action's reward and cost are observed, with a general reward class and a convex class of nonlinear cost functions. We propose CS-UCCB, which combines offline regression, cost confidence sets, and upper counterfactual confidence bounds. Each regression fit defines a valid cost confidence set, while a geometry derived from covering entropy controls cumulative cost uncertainty along the sampled decisions. Under polylogarithmic covering entropy for both classes and polylogarithmic offline estimation error, the finite-action algorithm guarantees, with high probability, feasibility at every round and $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(\sqrt T)$ regret without an eluder-dimension term. translated_title: 基于离线回归实现逐阶段约束上下文赌博机的无Eluder维度遗憾
translated_abstract: 具有逐阶段约束的上下文赌博机对一类决策问题进行建模，这类决策必须在学习其结果的同时控制风险。我们研究仅能观测到所选动作的奖励与代价的情形，其中奖励函数属于一般函数类，代价函数属于一类凸的非线性函数。我们提出了CS-UCCB算法，该算法结合了离线回归、代价置信集以及上反事实置信界。每次回归拟合都定义了一个有效的代价置信集，而由覆盖熵导出的几何结构则控制着沿采样决策的累积代价不确定性。在两个函数类均具有多对数级覆盖熵且离线估计误差为多对数级的条件下，该有限动作算法以高概率保证每一轮的可行性，并实现Õ(√T)的遗憾界，且不含eluder维度项。在显式的奖励设计条件下，我们还将分析扩展到无限动作的情形……
tldr: 提出CS-UCCB算法，通过结合离线回归、代价置信集与上反事实置信界，在逐阶段约束的上下文赌博机中首次实现了不含eluder维度项的Õ(√T)遗憾界，同时以高概率保证每一轮的代价可行性。
en_tdlr: Proposes CS-UCCB, which combines offline regression, cost confidence sets, and upper counterfactual confidence bounds to achieve Õ(√T) regret free of eluder-dimension terms for stage-wise constrained contextual bandits, while guaranteeing per-round feasibility with high probability.
